## 正文

I used ChatGPT to generate a Python script for this purpose. The JSON file seems to be created, but I'm encountering issues with downloading and saving the images. Additionally, when I try to download the files from ChatGPT's environment, I receive an error message: Failed to get upload status for /mnt/data/ FileName . I have searched similar problem on ChatGpt forum and found this thread . No solution till now. Can anybody help?
